claims: Tems and Wizkid are Nigerian artists.
Justin Bieber brought out Tems and Wizkid as surprise guests during his headlining Coachella 2026 set on April 12, 2026.
Justin Bieber, Tems, and Wizkid performed "Essence (Remix)" during the Coachella 2026 set.
Justin Bieber's Coachella 2026 set consisted of 34 songs.
Justin Bieber brought out Wizkid and then Tems during his Coachella 2026 set.
Justin Bieber, Wizkid, and Tems performed a rendition of "Essence" during the Coachella 2026 set.
Justin Bieber shifted to Afrobeats during his Coachella 2026 set.
Tems and Justin Bieber previously collaborated on the track "I Think You're Special".
"I Think You're Special" is from Justin Bieber's 2025 album SWAG II.
Justin Bieber's Coachella 2026 performance followed a four-year break from major live performances by Justin Bieber.
